news.title: Africa’s Moment? The Battle To Host Football’s 2030 World Cup Final
news.lede: Football’s ultimate fixture awaits its scheduling. The first major triumph of the 2030 World Cup will come long before the kick-off of the tournament, to be co-hosted by Morocco, Portugal and Spain. It will be the decision on which of the three countries gets the prestige of hosting the final, a call that world football’s governing body, FIFA, will make. Exactly when is unclear, and each passing month only heightens the tension ahead of the announcement.

news.title: Gianni Infantino: Fifa president proposes external review of world football's governing body
news.lede: Gianni Infantino was first elected as Fifa president in 2016. Fifa president Gianni Infantino has proposed an external review of how world football's governing body operates, and says he is open to reform. In a letter sent to members of the Fifa Council and all of its national associations, Infantino explains the independent process would "recommend potential improvements". Before a meeting of the Council next month, Infantino says he is also suggesting a consultation on "how Fifa's decision-making can be further strengthened".

news.title: Spain Extend World Cup-Winning Coach De la Fuente’s Contract Until 2032
news.lede: Rabat - The Royal Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) has officially extended national team coach Luis de la Fuente’s contract until 2032, rewarding the manager following Spain’s triumph at the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The federation announced on Monday that its board of directors had unanimously approved the agreement during a meeting at its headquarters in Las Rozas, Madrid. De la Fuente’s previous contract was due to expire in 2028. The new agreement extends his tenure by four years and ensures continuity through Spain’s upcoming major international competitions.

news.title: The European Dude Who Fell In Love With American Culture During World Cup Posts Video In Awe Of College Football
news.lede: (Photo by Michael Chang/Getty Images). The German tourist who fell in love with American culture during the 2026 FIFA World Cup is back in the States and posted a video Saturday showing the electric atmosphere of Auburn University’s Jordan-Hare Stadium. Known online as “Freddy,” the European won over the hearts of countless Americans over the summer by chronicling his road trip tour through the South and Middle America and expressing genuine amazement at things many Americans take for granted, such as Waffle Houses, nice suburban neighborhoods and large gas stations. news.title: Turkey national football team: full squad and key players
news.lede: Vincenzo Montella has named his first squad since the World Cup, and the group waiting for it is the hardest in the competition. Here is who made it, who could not, and what the caps column says. Vincenzo Montella named a 29-man Turkey squad on 18 September 2026 for the country’s opening UEFA Nations League fixtures, at home to France on 25 September and Italy on 28 September, away to Belgium on 2 October and Italy again on 5 October. It is the first squad he has picked since the World Cup, and it is missing two of the players the World Cup was built around.
